name: Fremont Recreation part-time jobs (Sports Instructor at 15+)
what_you_do: Work part time for the city's rec programs. Teens 15 and up can be a Sports Instructor or a Tennis Instructor. The Aqua Adventure Waterpark also hires for guest services and water safety.
who_can_apply: Each job lists its own age. Sports Instructor jobs are for ages 15 and up. Cooking, After School and Facility jobs are for ages 18 and up. You do not need work experience.
pay_detail: Sports and Tennis Instructor: $18.05 to $25.54 per hour.
duration: Seasonal and year-round part-time jobs, with day, evening and weekend shifts.
deadline_text: The program page lists current openings and says to apply online. No closing date is given.
how_to_apply: Look at the current openings and apply online. No work experience? List volunteer work, clubs, group projects and sports teams. Questions: (510) 494-4347.
notes: Workers must get CPR, First Aid and AED training within 30 days of being hired. The city offers classes. Fingerprints and a TB test are also required. See each job description for the full list.
